Sapphire supplemental Wiki translation corpus

Source: Hypixel SkyBlock Wiki contributors
https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/
Source content is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported.
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/
Wiki licensing information: https://meta.weirdgloop.org/w/Licensing

Chinese translations and extracted text in translations/community-wiki.json are
adaptations of the attributed Wiki source content and are provided under the same
CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 license. Each entry retains source-page and revision attribution.
The Wiki article history identifies contributors. Collection dates, raw source,
revision IDs, and extraction limitations are retained in translation-review/wiki-corpus-20261023.

This supplementary data is separate from Sapphire code and from the GPL-licensed
SkyBlockZH corpus. Existing Sapphire and SkyBlockZH translations retain priority.
No endorsement by Hypixel, the Wiki, or its contributors is implied.

The creature-messages.json supplement (2026-10-30) adapts fishing and combat
notices from the same Wiki under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, with source and revision URLs
on each extracted entry. Entity reference attribution is retained in
translation-review/entities-20261030/catalog.json in the source project.

Dungeon supplement (2026-11-03): the Three Weirdos statements, trivia question
bank and Archer ability descriptions in system-messages.json and
tooltip-paragraphs.json also adapt game-text transcriptions from the Wiki under
CC BY-NC-SA 3.0. Their Chinese translations are original adaptations.
Sources (page history credits the Wiki contributors):
https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Catacombs_Puzzle_Rooms?oldid=866660
https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Archer?oldid=865954
Research and cross-check references are retained in
translation-state/dungeon-supplement-20261103/sources.json.
